The archive will list **published posts** in coverage-date order. A coverage
date is an editorial label, not a claim about when analysis was performed.

## Planned coverage

The editorial sequence is groceries from June 2023 to May 2024, electricity
from June 2024 to September 2025, fantasy football from October 2025 to January
2026, and learning analytics from February 2026 to June 2027. These are
coverage periods, not verified dates of work. A separate portfolio summary is
planned for June 2027.
